profile.headline: Web Developer / Entreprenuer
profile.summary:
I’m a web developer and digital strategist with 15+ years of experience helping organizations build, improve, and scale their online presence.

My work has spanned agencies, startups, and enterprise environments, contributing to digital initiatives for organizations including the Beaumont Enterprise (a Hearst daily newspaper), Pervasive Software, Clarity Ventures, BigCommerce, and CapMetro.

I’ve led and contributed to multiple website redesigns, delivering measurable impact—including increasing website traffic by 40% and new visitor growth by 20% or more. My experience includes front-end development, UX/UI collaboration, enterprise CMS management, analytics, and platform optimization, often serving as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders.

Earlier in my career, I was recognized for my research and technical contributions, including published presentations at the Texas Academy of Science Annual Meeting and the Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing. I also participated in outreach and research development programs at Lamar University, including WiReD (Women in Research Development) and INSPIRED (Increasing Student Participation in Research Development).

I’m known for strong communication, problem-solving, and adaptability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in fast-paced environments. I bring a balance of technical expertise and creative thinking, focused on building digital experiences that are practical, scalable, and user-centered.

Fluent in English and Tagalog, and proficient in Spanish.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer / Consultant
positions.description:
As a Web Developer and Consultant, I partner with small businesses and organizations to build, optimize, and scale their digital presence through strategic web development, hosting solutions, and marketing technology. I lead end-to-end website projects—from discovery and platform selection to design, development, and launch—ensuring each solution aligns with long-term business goals.

My work includes developing and managing websites such as MIG Electric, FYP ATX, and Beltran Electric, along with eCommerce and content-driven platforms. I specialize in WordPress, WooCommerce, and small business infrastructure, while also advising on SEO, performance optimization, and user experience.

Beyond execution, I bring an entrepreneurial lens—helping clients identify growth opportunities, streamline operations, and build sustainable online ecosystems.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · User Experience · Web Development · Strategic Consulting · Marketing Strategy

positions.title: Division Leader
positions.description:
As a licensed Life Agent and Division Leader, I help individuals and families build strong financial foundations through education, protection strategies, and long-term planning. I am certified in annuities and maintain ongoing professional development through ethics and compliance training.

My approach focuses on empowering clients to increase income, eliminate debt, and achieve financial independence through personalized strategies. In addition to client services, I mentor and develop team members, fostering leadership growth, accountability, and long-term success within my division.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Web Developer on the Marketing Technology team, I contribute to the development, optimization, and ongoing maintenance of CapMetro’s web platforms, supporting accessible, user-focused digital experiences for the public.

I implement front-end enhancements, improve site performance, and support CMS-driven content management workflows. I collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Communications, and IT to translate business needs into scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with branding, accessibility standards, and organizational goals.

I also contribute to evaluating web technologies and best practices to enhance usability, performance, and long-term sustainability across the organization’s digital ecosystem.
positions.insights: Skills: Sitefinity · Web Development · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · CMS · Marketing

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
As Co-Founder of Beltran Electric, I built and scaled a service-based business from the ground up, overseeing operations, marketing, and technology. I developed and managed the company’s digital presence, including website strategy, lead generation, and branding, while supporting day-to-day business operations.

This experience strengthened my ability to bridge technical execution with real-world business needs—driving growth, improving customer acquisition, and establishing a strong market presence in the Pflugerville and greater Austin area. It also shaped my entrepreneurial approach to helping other small businesses succeed.
positions.insights: Skills: Start-up Ventures · Lead Generation · Management · Entrepreneurship

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Web Developer at Z5 Inventory, I managed and enhanced the company’s digital infrastructure, including their HubSpot-based website and CRM integration. I maintained site performance, implemented updates, and ensured alignment between marketing and operational systems.

I also supported business operations through technical management of hosting environments and Google Workspace, improving reliability and internal workflows. Additionally, I led the implementation of a BigCommerce store to facilitate the sale of surplus medical inventory, expanding revenue channels and creating a streamlined eCommerce experience for specialized products.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · HubSpot · BigCommerce · Google Workspace

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Responsible for continuous iteration on A/B testing efforts for Sparefoot.com to continually improve user experience and online presence based on data-driven results.  Collaborated on an agile development team, using HTML, CSS, PHP, Bootstrap, and various JavaScript libraries.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description: Responsible for coordinating projects and developing customized responsive websites for 3-5 clients using DotNetNuke (ASP.Net/C#) or Wordpress (PHP), HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, jQuery, AngularJS, Twitter Bootstrap, and Adobe Creative.

positions.title: Web Developer for Big Data & Analytics
positions.description: Actian & Pervasive unite to take action on Big Data

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Responsible for website development, design, SEO and user experience for Pervasive Software's Big Data & Analytics Sales & Marketing Team using DotNetNuke, HTML/CSS, Javascript, jQuery, Photoshop, and Dreamweaver.  Also proficient in Marketo and Salesforce.

positions.title: Assistant Online Producer
positions.description:
*	Work with a team responsible for interacting with editors, photographers and reporters to orchestrate print and online content with widely varying responsibilities in web development and multimedia.
*	Create, maintain and develop templates within the Clickability CMS platform using Velocity, Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
*	Led the technical aspects of the BeaumontEnterprise.com homepage redesign that dramatically increased web traffic.
*	Collaborated with teams across the Hearst Corporation (including Houston Chronicle, SFGate, News Times, and Times Union) in the migration of BeaumontEnterprise.com and MySA.com to the WCM platform.
*	Work with the Hearst Core and Local Development team in an agile environment to support the continuous need for change in the newspaper content management system using PHP, Smarty templating, and MySQL.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Develop site layout using Joomla and CSS.
* Upload text, image and other related content for the first issue of CuentameOnline.com scheduled to release Fall 2009

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: The INSPIRED Program is funded by the National Science Foundation [Grant No. 0634288] to encourage women and minorities to pursue a degree in CS by engaging them in research and outreach programs.  The INSPIRED Team conducts research in Robotics and Computer Architecture, and develops outreach programs to local schools to get other kids interested in Computer Science.
